content.enriched_brief: Create a warm, slow-paced 30-second premium lifestyle commercial for 'Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters' that sells the cozy 'morning ritual' and sense of calm. The video should focus on the tactile, visual pleasure of slowly brewing pour-over coffee rather than technical parameters, inspiring viewers to make their own. The aesthetic must be elegant, featuring the brand's minimalist logo: a clean brown oak leaf outline enclosing a warm orange flame, with the text 'EMBER & OAK COFFEE ROASTERS' below it. This logo should appear elegantly on the product packaging and as a refined end-screen graphic. No voiceover; the commercial relies on natural sounds, a gentle acoustic soundtrack, and soft, warm morning sunlight. Include a brief, elegant English slogan subtitle at the end to encapsulate this peaceful moment.
